name: party-cell
description: Real-time voice, video, and screen sharing cell powered by Cloudflare Calls WebRTC SFU

roomId.description: Room identifier for the call. Null = auto-generated from cell instance ID.

_discovery.describe: Real-time voice, video, and screen sharing cell powered by Cloudflare Calls SFU. Users can start or join a party call, share their camera/mic, broadcast their screen or 3D canvas, and see remote participants in a video grid. Uses Cloudflare Calls for signaling and media (no backend media processing), with room presence synchronised via Redis Pub/Sub.
use_cases: Voice/video call with party members while exploring 3D content
Broadcast 3D viewport to other users in the room
Social hangout in the planet hall
